description: This file defines the TouchInputMapper class and related data structures for handling touch input events in Android. It includes raw and cooked pointer data, input processing methods, calibration, and gesture handling specific to touch input devices.

classes.name: RawPointerAxes
classes.description: Stores raw axis information from the input driver for touch pointers.

classes.name: RawPointerData
classes.description: Holds raw data for a collection of pointers, including their IDs and states.

classes.name: CookedPointerData
classes.description: Stores processed (cooked) pointer data with properties and coordinates.

classes.name: TouchInputMapper
classes.description: Handles mapping and processing of touch input events, including gesture recognition and calibration.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Returns the input sources supported by this mapper.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the input mapper with new settings.

methods.name: getKeyCodeState
methods.description: Returns the state of a specific key code.

methods.name: getScanCodeState
methods.description: Returns the state of a specific scan code.

methods.name: updateExternalStylusState
methods.description: Updates the state of an external stylus.

methods.name: getAssociatedDisplayId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated display, if any.

methods.name: cookAndDispatch
methods.description: Cooks raw data and dispatches events.

methods.name: dispatchHoverEnterAndMove
methods.description: Dispatches hover enter and move events.

methods.name: cookPointerData
methods.description: Processes raw pointer data into cooked data.

methods.name: checkForTouchpadQuietTime
methods.description: Checks if touchpad gestures should be ignored due to quiet time.

methods.name: getFastestFinger
methods.description: Returns the fastest finger for gesture processing.

methods.name: moveMousePointerFromPointerDelta
methods.description: Moves mouse pointer based on pointer delta.

methods.name: isTouchScreen
methods.description: Checks if device is a touch screen.

methods.name: isPointInsidePhysicalFrame
methods.description: Checks if point is inside physical frame.

methods.name: findVirtualKeyHit
methods.description: Finds virtual key hit at given coordinates.

methods.name: assignPointerIds
methods.description: Assigns pointer IDs for touch points.

methods.name: computeDeviceType
methods.description: Computes device type based on context.
